source.description: Aggregated Search Console export supplied with the task. No raw CSV or daily rows were provided.

property.note: Requested target property. The supplied aggregate does not carry property metadata, so the property is stated by the task, not independently verified.

searchType.note: Task context says organic Google Search. The export metadata does not expose type; no other search type is assumed or merged.

filters.note: Top pages and top countries were supplied as separate extracts; their filters are not recorded.

timezone.note: Search Console property timezone was not supplied. No cross-source date joins are made.

dataState.note: The export is treated as final for its own dates, but daily rows are absent so GSC lag and finalisation cannot be verified from the file.

totals.note: Average position was not part of the supplied aggregate.

integrity.note: The -69.5% figure is the difference between two halves of the same 28-day window, not a comparison of the latest 28 days with the previous 28 days.

lagSafety.reason: A previous 28-day window (2026-09-23..2026-10-20) and daily rows were not supplied. Per-day completeness inside 2026-11-04..2026-11-17 cannot be checked.
